cc:Work.dc:title: Brass Birmingham — self-play PL strength
cc:Work.dc:description: Common-fit PL progression through generation 1500: 30 displayed points from 150 checkpoints (cap 30). Adjacent checkpoints averaged for display; first/latest remain exact. Recent detail covers generations 1300–1500: all 21 points exact, with a separate y-axis. Unmodified pointwise 95% setup-bootstrap intervals. Latest 491.386, interval [446.897, 529.601]. Paired change versus generation 1490: -85.017, 95% interval [-134.280, -32.902]. Latest slot: 128 games / 32 setups; Common fit: 19,200 games; 150 rated checkpoints. IL anchor 0; v4 reference 64.977.
